title: Act: Add isIgnoredByDirRule helper for .gitignore directory rules
summary: Pure helper that tells whether a path is ignored by directory rules
description: Add game/frontend/src/lib/gitignore.ts exporting isIgnoredByDirRule(ignoreText, path) that returns true when some non-comment line ending in `/` without other slashes equals a path segment, and handles anchored rules (containing a slash) by prefix match.
acceptance_criteria: Given `node_modules/` and path a/b/node_modules/x, then true
Given `game/node_modules/` and path game/frontend/node_modules/x, then false

steps.action: Export isIgnoredByDirRule(ignoreText: string, path: string): boolean. Split into trimmed lines, skip empty and # lines. For each rule ending in '/', strip the trailing slash; if it has no '/', return true when the directory segments of the path include it; if it has a '/', return true when path starts with rule + '/'.
steps.code: export function isIgnoredByDirRule(ignoreText: string, path: string): boolean { const dirs = path.split('/').slice(0, -1); for (const raw of ignoreText.split('\n')) { const line = raw.trim(); if (!line || line.startsWith('#') || !line.endsWith('/')) continue; const rule = line.slice(0, -1); if (rule.includes('/') ? path.startsWith(rule + '/') : dirs.includes(rule)) return true; } return false; }
steps.expected: Function compiles and returns booleans per the criteria
